_what: The architect's sheets against the engineer's (crossdisc.rs, Q6612): every electrical object the architect draws (a light on a reflected ceiling plan, a receptacle or a data outlet on a floor plan, a fan) compared room by room with what the electrical sheets draw, both ways. Each kind is a row of `kinds`: how the architect's legend names it, which engineer's devices are it, how far apart two sheets may draw one object, what the build makes of an object only the architect draws.
_basis: Trade practice and the documents' own order: the architectural reflected ceiling plans, floor plans and interior elevations locate what the owner sees; the electrical plans give type, circuit and control. One object on one sheet and not on the other is a coordination gap the field finds on site; the electrician builds what the architect shows and asks for its type and circuit.
_architect_disciplines: The sheet disciplines whose drawings are the architect's (architecture, interiors).
_architect_sheet_kinds: The architect's sheets read for objects: reflected ceiling plans, floor plans, enlarged plans (each placed on its level's plan).
_legend_title_words: A short heading holding one of these words heads a legend: the rows under it are its drawing beside its words.
_legend_title_max_words: A heading of more words is a note that mentions a legend, not one.
_legend_rows_h: A legend's rows reach at most this many row heights under its heading.
_legend_gap_h: A gap of more than this many row heights between two rows ends the legend (rows are spaced by their drawings: a ceiling tile's square, a fixture's bar); so does a heading taller than its rows under it.
_legend_drawing_h: A row's drawing lies at most this many row heights left of its words.

kinds.name: lights
kinds._reach_ft: Two sheets' copies of one light this near on the level's plan are one light (sheet registration and the electrical plan's schematic placing).
kinds._count_tolerance: Counts in one room that differ by more than this (and by more than a quarter of the larger) are a finding.
kinds._rooms_without: A room with a ceiling and no light on any sheet is a finding (lower severity).

build.proposed_control: a single-pole switch at the room's door (NEC 210.70: a lighting outlet controlled by a switch at the entrance)
build.proposed_circuit: the nearest lighting circuit of the level the electrical plans give

kinds.name: powered door hardware (operators, card readers, electric strikes)

rooms._min_area_sqft: A smaller room (a closet, a chase) is not asked about when it has no light.
rooms._except_words: A room named with one of these words needs no light of its own (closets and chases; an elevator's car is its vendor's).
rooms._reach_ft: An object this near a room (just outside its traced outline: a wall's thickness) is that room's.

_max_findings: Findings filed per run at most (one per room and kind); the rest are counted in the report.
_max_sketches: Marked-up plan crops made per run at most (the architect-only findings first).
